text: Entry 1164 adds test_encodesMultiByteCharactersToQR using the six characters ⅝⅜⅝⅞™⅛. The byte check finds 18 UTF-8 bytes: every character in this fixture uses three bytes, even though the commit subject mentions two-byte characters. The accepted task retains the text and snapshot equality assertion. This fixture verifies an encoding example and serialized output when run; it does not cover every Unicode length, decode a QR code, or prove Android import. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
